checks.reason: Only Alchimie items gain one mandatory strict lowercase SHA256 field. Both raw item hashes must equal the supplied immutable byte buffer; preserved judgments and existing V2 audit fields agree.

Both input ID arrays must agree, identities differ case-insensitively, raw item coverage is exact, dossier inventory is exact/fresh/current-pending. Any Alchimie member requires a sorted Alchimie-only batch.

Private staging first reproduces the full archived projection through unchanged validated_artifact, then validates current pack/KG/rubric/runtime/generator/source record hashes. Coordinated restamping of changed rows cannot replace replay validation.
All artifact and live-source checks complete inside private staging before write_outputs. Exception cleanup removes private staging; output prechecks reject stale games/dossiers/audit before copying.
Original audit bytes are copied directly; builder never regenerates evidence or fills missing reviewer fields. Existing synthesized gate policy is unchanged.
No changes to apply_rereview, audit generator, Alchimie runtime or pack rules. The strict prospective-inventory gate remains required at apply time.

Independently decoded and hash-verified actual 44-test initial, 102-critique and 45-test final logs. Final tests exercise 21 evidence failures, byte-preserving output, mixed games, unsorted IDs and stale non-Alchimie audit. No heavy suite was rerun.
Guide matches CLI and current audit contract. ADR0129 records exact extension and limits; ADR0104 changes only its superseded status pointer.

limits: Agent code review is not independent human acceptance of any content.
Distinct reviewer IDs are an audit contract, not cryptographic proof of separate people.

As before, publication uses per-file atomic writes rather than an atomic directory transaction; unexpected filesystem I/O failure can leave partial artifact output, which the unchanged applier validates before pack mutation.
Full integration is the orchestrator responsibility and is not claimed by the focused author receipts.
